universal-father.reason: The papers call him 'the Father' about 5,800 times, and 'the Paradise Father' (1:1.5). Without these names, a reader's term list misses him in most paragraphs.

first-source-and-center.reason: 'The Universal Father is the God of all creation, the First Source and Center of all things and beings.' The record has no citations and points to the Universal Father.

god-the-father.reason: A name of the Universal Father. The record has no citations and points to the Universal Father.

abraham-old-testament.reason: 'Father Abraham' names the patriarch (121:7.3, 169:3.2), not the Universal Father.

moses.reason: 'your Father Moses' (174:3.2) names Moses, not the Universal Father.
